# Vendored: swagger-ui-dist

Swagger UI 5.33.0 (Apache-2.0), copied unmodified from the `swagger-ui-dist` npm package:
`swagger-ui-bundle.js`, `swagger-ui.css`, `LICENSE`, `NOTICE`, `swagger-ui-bundle.js.LICENSE.txt`.
Only `swagger-initializer.js` is ours.

Vendored (not loaded from a CDN) so the API docs page works on an IP-locked internal instance and does
not execute third-party script from a CDN. To upgrade: download a newer `swagger-ui-dist` tarball, replace
the five files above, and update this version line.
